neighbours.label: leaving a record or legacy behind: ' behind' after left or leave, ' down' in 'set down', ' form' after 'written', firing there; building something and leaving a place stay low
fire: The old master left behind a large body of drawings.
Although she never set down her methods in written form, she taught.
These settlers did not leave behind many letters.
Monks since 900 have left behind a wealth of chronicles.
He left behind a collection of essays and a diary.
She set down her memories in a small notebook.
The early printers left behind few records of their shops.
Socrates never set down his teaching in written form.
quiet: The old master built a large house of stone.
Although she never met her brother in the city, she called.
These settlers did not grow many vegetables.

Socrates never traveled far from the city walls.

short: left behind a legacy; set down in writing
